steps.cmd: gamemode creative DPTester1
execute as DPTester1 at @s run function veinminer:_config
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:coal_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:coal_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.diamond_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:iron_pickaxe
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:iron_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:iron_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.iron_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:fortune":3}]
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:deepslate_diamond_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:deepslate_diamond_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.diamond_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:netherite_pickaxe[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:silk_touch":1}]
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:gold_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:gold_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.netherite_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone_pickaxe[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:fortune":2}]
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:redstone_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:redstone_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.stone_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:wooden_pickaxe[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:fortune":1}]
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:copper_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:copper_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.wooden_pickaxe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:emerald_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:emerald_ore
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.diamond_pickaxe 1
execute as DPTester1 at @s run function veinminer:block_add {namespace:"minecraft",id:"oak_log",category:"axe"}
execute as DPTester1 at @s run function veinminer:tool_add {namespace:"minecraft",id:"diamond_axe",category:"axe"}
execute as DPTester1 at @s run function veinminer:block_add {namespace:"minecraft",id:"dirt",category:"shovel"}
execute as DPTester1 at @s run function veinminer:tool_add {namespace:"minecraft",id:"diamond_shovel",category:"shovel"}
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_axe
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:oak_log
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:oak_log
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.diamond_axe 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_shovel
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:dirt
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:dirt
scoreboard players set DPTester1 veinminer.t.minecraft.diamond_shovel 1
scoreboard players set sneak veinminer.settings 1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~ ~ ~ ~3 ~2 ~3 minecraft:coal_ore
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~ ~7 ~ ~ minecraft:coal_ore

item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe
